question: Several years after a teenage boy and his younger brother witnessed a gang related murder, they both decided to come forward and report it to authorities. The older brother describes the horrific decapitation of the gang member without displaying any emotion; but when the younger brother was asked about the crime, he had no recollection of the event. Which two ego defenses are being displayed by these brothers, respectively?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Witnessed gang-related murder -> Traumatic event -> Psychological defense mechanisms -> Ego defenses -> Isolation of affect; Repression -> 80% CHAIN: Older brother describes decapitation without emotion -> Isolation of affect -> Repression -> 75% CHAIN: Younger brother has no recollection of the event -> Psychological defense mechanisms -> Ego defenses -> Dissociation -> 80%
analysis: The older brother displaying no emotion while describing the horrific event suggests isolation of affect, a defense mechanism where emotions are separated from the associated thoughts or memories. The younger brother having no recollection of the event indicates repression, a defense mechanism where distressing thoughts or memories are pushed into the unconscious mind.
